name: For a Better Community
pron: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
grammar: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while

notes.title: Quá khứ đơn và quá khứ tiếp diễn với when và while
notes.body:
1. Cách dùng
• Quá khứ tiếp diễn (was/were + V-ing): hành động ĐANG diễn ra tại một thời điểm trong quá khứ (hành động dài, làm nền).
• Quá khứ đơn (V-ed / cột 2): hành động ngắn xen vào, cắt ngang hành động đang diễn ra.

2. Cấu trúc
• S + was/were + V-ing + when + S + V2/ed.
• While + S + was/were + V-ing, S + V2/ed.
• When + S + V2/ed, S + was/were + V-ing.
• Hai hành động dài song song: While + S + was/were + V-ing, S + was/were + V-ing.
→ WHILE thường đi với hành động dài (quá khứ tiếp diễn); WHEN thường đi với hành động ngắn (quá khứ đơn).

3. Dấu hiệu nhận biết: when, while, at that time, at 8 p.m. yesterday, at this time last week…

4. Ví dụ
• I was reading an article when she called. / While I was reading an article, she called.
• Oh, when you came, I was working as a volunteer at our local centre for community development.
• Last summer, while I was visiting the centre, I saw an advertisement for volunteers.
• They were cleaning the streets when it started to rain.
• While Nam was painting the classroom, his friends were repairing the tables.

5. Lỗi hay gặp
• Dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn cho hành động ngắn: ✗ when I was arriving → ✓ when I arrived.
• Dùng during thay cho while trước mệnh đề: ✗ during we were helping → ✓ while we were helping (during + danh từ: during the trip).
• Đảo vai trò: ✗ While I saw the news, I was watching TV → ✓ While I was watching TV, I saw the news.
• Quên chia was/were theo chủ ngữ: they were, she was.

notes.title: Trọng âm của từ hai âm tiết có cùng cách viết (danh từ – động từ)
notes.body:
Quy tắc: nhiều từ hai âm tiết vừa là danh từ vừa là động từ, cách viết giống nhau:
• Danh từ → trọng âm ở âm tiết 1: a 'record, an 'increase, a 'present, an 'export, an 'import.
• Động từ → trọng âm ở âm tiết 2: to re'cord, to in'crease, to pre'sent, to ex'port, to im'port.

Ví dụ trong sách:
• The centre keeps a 'record of all donations. (danh từ)
• We will re'cord the charity live show… (động từ)
• There was an 'increase in house prices last year. / We want to in'crease students' interest…
• I got this 'present from a visitor. / When will you pre'sent your report?

Cách làm bài: xác định từ loại của từ trong câu (sau a/an/the/tính từ → danh từ; sau to/will/can/chủ ngữ → động từ) rồi suy ra trọng âm.

Lưu ý: không phải từ nào cũng đổi trọng âm: an 'answer – to 'answer; a 'picture – to 'picture.
Một số từ khác của Unit: do'nate, re'mote, 'generous, 'orphanage, do'nation, ˌvolun'teer.

notes.title: Hậu tố tính từ: -ed / -ing; -ful / -less
notes.body:
• -ed: diễn tả cảm giác của người (bị làm cho cảm thấy): excited, interested, bored, confused, worried.
• -ing: diễn tả tính chất của vật/việc/người gây ra cảm giác: exciting, interesting, boring, confusing.
  Ví dụ: I am interested in community development activities. / I find community work very interesting.
• -ful: đầy, có tính chất: careful (cẩn thận), helpful, hopeful, useful, successful, thankful.
• -less: không có, thiếu: careless (bất cẩn), hopeless (vô vọng; rất kém), endless (vô tận), homeless (vô gia cư), helpless (bất lực).
  Ví dụ: There are endless opportunities for getting involved. / Last year, I was hopeless at maths.
Lỗi hay gặp: ✗ I am interesting in volunteering → ✓ I am interested in volunteering; nhầm careful/careless, hopeful/hopeless vì nghĩa trái ngược.

notes.title: Từ vựng và cụm từ về phát triển cộng đồng
notes.body:
• donate money/food/clothes (to a charity) – quyên góp; donation (n): generous donations.
• volunteer (n, v) – tình nguyện viên; tình nguyện: volunteer at an orphanage.
• generous (adj) – hào phóng; remote area – vùng xa xôi hẻo lánh.
• benefit (v) the people / the community – mang lại lợi ích cho.
• raise money (for charity) – quyên tiền; ✗ rise money.
• get involved in / participate in / take part in – tham gia.
• apply for a volunteer position – ứng tuyển; fill in a form – điền đơn; application – đơn ứng tuyển.
• boost confidence – tăng sự tự tin; build essential life skills – rèn kĩ năng sống thiết yếu; find a sense of purpose – tìm ra mục đích sống.
• help at a food bank; deliver free meals to poor families; sell handmade items.
• non-governmental organisation (NGO) – tổ chức phi chính phủ; non-profit organisation – tổ chức phi lợi nhuận.

notes.title: Mẹo làm bài
notes.body:
• Chia thì với when/while: tìm hành động DÀI (đang diễn ra → was/were + V-ing) và hành động NGẮN xen vào (V2/ed). While thường đứng trước hành động dài; when thường đứng trước hành động ngắn. Hai hành động dài song song → cả hai dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn.
• Câu có thời điểm cụ thể trong quá khứ (at 8 p.m. yesterday, at this time last Sunday) → quá khứ tiếp diễn.
• While/when + mệnh đề (S + V); during + danh từ. Gặp "during + S + V" trong bài tìm lỗi → sửa thành while.
• Tính từ -ed/-ing: chủ ngữ là người cảm thấy → -ed (interested, excited); sự vật/việc gây cảm giác → -ing (interesting, exciting).
• -ful/-less nghĩa trái ngược: đọc kĩ vế sau của câu để chọn (careful ↔ careless, hopeful ↔ hopeless, helpful ↔ helpless).
• Word form: sau tính từ cần danh từ (generous donations); trước danh từ cần tính từ (endless opportunities); sau be cần tính từ.
• Trọng âm từ hai âm tiết cùng cách viết: xác định từ loại trong câu – danh từ nhấn âm 1, động từ nhấn âm 2 (a 'record / to re'cord).
• Collocation hay ra: raise money (không dùng rise), donate sth to a charity, apply for a position, fill in a form, get involved in, participate in = take part in, boost confidence, a sense of purpose.

vocab.ex: Our club needs more volunteers to clean up the park at the weekend.
I was working as a volunteer at our local centre for community development.

vocab.vi: công tác phục vụ cộng đồng
vocab.ex: Community service not only benefits the local area, but can also boost our confidence.

vocab.vi: quảng cáo, thông báo tuyển người
vocab.ex: While I was visiting the centre, I saw an advertisement for volunteers.
Sounds good. How can I apply?
I applied, and my application was successful.
Hope your application is successful, and you enjoy the work.

vocab.vi: mang lại lợi ích cho; có lợi
vocab.ex: This clean water project will benefit the people in the village.
Community service can also boost our confidence and help us learn many useful skills.
Volunteering helped her build confidence when talking to strangers.
There are endless opportunities for getting involved.
Many students want to get involved in community activities.
You can join a local environmental group or volunteer at an orphanage.
I'll email you the form. You just fill it in and send it in.

vocab.vi: hào hứng, phấn khởi (cảm giác của người)
vocab.ex: I'm so excited about volunteering at the centre.
I find community work very interesting.
If you don't have time to volunteer, you can donate money and food.

vocab.vi: sự quyên góp; đồ/tiền quyên góp
vocab.ex: The centre keeps a record of all donations.
He is very generous. He is always willing to give a lot of money to charity.
The school is difficult to get to because it is located in a remote area.
We need to be careful when we record the donations.
A careless mistake in the donation record can cause problems.
I am interested in community development activities.

vocab.vi: thú vị, hấp dẫn (gây hào hứng)
vocab.ex: There are exciting volunteering opportunities in our community.
We are hopeful that more teenagers will join the project.
Last year, I was hopeless at maths.
The local people were so friendly and helpful.

vocab.vi: (n) bản ghi, sổ ghi chép; (v) ghi lại, ghi âm/ghi hình
vocab.ex: The centre keeps a record of all donations.
We want to increase students' interest in volunteering at the community centre.

vocab.vi: (n) món quà; (v) trình bày, trao tặng
vocab.ex: I got this present from a visitor to our centre.
We need to help local businesses to export their products.
Save the Children is an international non-governmental organisation.

vocab.vi: nhiều loại khác nhau, đa dạng
vocab.ex: It has organised various volunteering activities for all students to participate.
All students can participate in the club's activities.
One of the most popular activities of our club is selling handmade items.
Last year, we also raised over one hundred million VND to help people in flooded areas.
It offers other volunteering activities, such as delivering free meals to poor families.
We sell handmade items to raise money for the local orphanage.
The money is used to help homeless old people.

vocab.vi: ngân hàng thực phẩm (nơi phát thực phẩm miễn phí)
vocab.ex: Teenagers can volunteer by helping at a food bank.
Volunteering has helped me gain life experiences and find my sense of purpose in life.
When I see suffering and hardships, I feel thankful for what I have.
When I see suffering and hardships, I feel thankful for what I have.
These activities help me build essential life skills.
New volunteers will be trained by experienced volunteers.

passages.title: A volunteer trip to the mountains
passages.text:
Last summer, a group of students from my school joined a volunteer project (1) _____ by a local non-profit organisation. The aim of the project was to help a poor village in a remote mountain area. Before the trip, we (2) _____ money by selling handmade cards and cakes at the school gate. Many parents and teachers were very generous and (3) _____ clothes, books and school supplies.
When we arrived, the villagers welcomed us warmly. During the week, we repaired the classrooms, painted the walls and taught the children some English songs. One afternoon, while we (4) _____ the school garden, it suddenly started to rain heavily, but nobody stopped working. The whole experience was really (5) _____. It helped us understand the hardships of people in remote areas and made us feel thankful for what we have.

passages.title: Our first volunteer jobs
passages.text:
Last month, my best friend Lan and I decided to (6) _____ for volunteer positions at a food bank near our school. We saw the advertisement (7) _____ we were walking home from school one afternoon. The food bank needed reliable and hard-working teenagers to help at the weekend, so we filled in the application forms online and sent them in on the same day.
A week later, we were invited to an interview. The manager, (8) _____ had worked there for ten years, asked us why we wanted to do the job. I told her that I really cared about people in need and wanted to offer my help. Lan was a bit nervous at first, but she answered all the questions confidently. Luckily, both of our applications were (9) _____. Now every Saturday morning, we sort donations and deliver free meals to poor families. The work is tiring, but it makes us feel (10) _____ for what we have.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: A person who does a job without being paid for it is called a(n) _____.
questions.explain: volunteer = tình nguyện viên, người làm việc không lấy lương. employee = nhân viên (có lương); donor = người quyên góp; orphan = trẻ mồ côi.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: He is very _____. He is always willing to give a lot of money and time to people in need.
questions.explain: generous = hào phóng, sẵn lòng cho đi – khớp với vế sau "luôn sẵn lòng cho nhiều tiền và thời gian". remote = xa xôi; careless = bất cẩn; hopeless = vô vọng.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: The school is difficult to get to because it is located in a _____ area in the mountains.
questions.explain: remote area = vùng xa xôi hẻo lánh, nên khó đi đến. Các tính từ còn lại (thành công, cẩn thận, hào phóng) không dùng để mô tả khu vực khó tiếp cận.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: If you don't have time to volunteer, you can _____ money, clothes or books to the charity.
questions.explain: donate something to a charity = quyên góp cái gì cho tổ chức từ thiện. benefit = mang lợi ích cho (không đi với "money to"); participate phải đi với in; apply = nộp đơn.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: This clean water project will _____ thousands of people in the village.
questions.explain: benefit somebody = mang lại lợi ích cho ai: dự án nước sạch sẽ mang lại lợi ích cho hàng nghìn người dân. donate/deliver/raise không đi với tân ngữ chỉ người theo nghĩa này.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: I am very _____ in community development activities.
questions.explain: be interested in = quan tâm, thích thú đến. Tính từ đuôi -ed chỉ cảm giác của người (I). interesting (-ing) mô tả sự vật gây hứng thú; interest là danh từ/động từ; interestingly là trạng từ.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: There are many _____ volunteering opportunities for teenagers in our city.
questions.explain: Cần tính từ đứng trước danh từ opportunities; cơ hội là thứ GÂY hào hứng → dùng đuôi -ing: exciting. excited chỉ cảm giác của người; excite là động từ; excitement là danh từ.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: We need to be _____ when we record the donations so that no mistakes are made.
questions.explain: Sau be cần tính từ; ngữ cảnh "để không có sai sót" → careful (cẩn thận). careless = bất cẩn (trái nghĩa); carefully là trạng từ; care là danh từ/động từ.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: Last year, I was _____ at maths. I couldn't even do simple addition in my head.
questions.explain: be hopeless at something = rất kém về môn gì. Câu sau (không làm nổi phép cộng đơn giản) cho thấy rất kém. hopeful = đầy hi vọng; helpful/useful = hữu ích.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Our charity group received generous _____ from the local people.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ generous cần danh từ → donations (những khoản quyên góp). Câu: Nhóm từ thiện nhận được những khoản quyên góp hào phóng từ người dân địa phương.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: There are _____ opportunities for teenagers to volunteer these days.
questions.explain: Trước danh từ opportunities cần tính từ; endless = vô tận, rất nhiều (-less: không có giới hạn/kết thúc). ending/ended không mang nghĩa này; endlessly là trạng từ.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: The local people were really _____. They supported us all the time we stayed there.
questions.explain: Câu sau "họ hỗ trợ chúng tôi suốt thời gian ở đó" → helpful (hay giúp đỡ). helpless = bất lực, mâu thuẫn ngữ cảnh; helping không dùng làm tính từ chỉ tính cách; helpfully là trạng từ.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Last year, our club _____ over one hundred million VND to help people in flooded areas.
questions.explain: Collocation raise money = quyên góp, gây quỹ. rose (rise) là nội động từ, không có tân ngữ; grew/lifted không đi với money theo nghĩa quyên góp.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: I'll email you the form. You just _____ and send it in.
questions.explain: fill in a form = điền vào mẫu đơn (câu trong Getting Started). give up = từ bỏ; take off = cởi ra/cất cánh; look after = chăm sóc.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q:
Choose the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
Our club organises <u>various</u> volunteering activities for all students.
questions.explain: various = nhiều loại khác nhau, đồng nghĩa several different (theo phần Reading tr. 45). similar = giống nhau (gần như trái nghĩa); boring = nhàm chán; expensive = đắt.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q:
Choose the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
All students are encouraged to <u>participate</u> in the clean-up campaign.
questions.explain: participate in = take part in (tham gia). take over = tiếp quản; take after = giống (người thân); take off = cất cánh/cởi ra.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
The volunteers were <u>careful</u> when they sorted the donations.
questions.explain: careful (cẩn thận) trái nghĩa với careless (bất cẩn). cautious = thận trọng (gần nghĩa); hopeful, thankful không liên quan.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
The village is in a <u>remote</u> area, so it is difficult for children to get to school.
questions.explain: remote = xa xôi, hẻo lánh; trái nghĩa là central (ở trung tâm, thuận tiện). distant, isolated, far-off đều gần nghĩa với remote.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Community service can _____ our confidence and help us learn many useful skills.
questions.explain: boost confidence = tăng sự tự tin, phù hợp vế "giúp học nhiều kĩ năng hữu ích". reduce (giảm), lose (mất), waste (lãng phí) trái với ý tích cực của câu.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: When I see the suffering and _____ of people in flooded areas, I feel thankful for what I have.
questions.explain: hardships = những gian khổ, khó khăn; thấy người khác khổ nên biết ơn những gì mình có. benefits (lợi ích), donations (đồ quyên góp), opportunities (cơ hội) không hợp lôgic.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: While Lan _____ as a volunteer in the countryside, she met an old friend.
questions.explain: While + quá khứ tiếp diễn diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra (dài) thì hành động ngắn "met" xen vào → was working. Các thì hiện tại không hợp với met (quá khứ).

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: I was revising for my civics class when my dad _____ me about the volunteer job.
questions.explain: Hành động ngắn xen vào hành động đang diễn ra (was revising) dùng quá khứ đơn sau when → told.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: We _____ the streets when it started to rain, so we had to stop and go home.
questions.explain: Việc dọn đường đang diễn ra thì trời đổ mưa (ngắn, xen vào) và phải dừng lại → were cleaning. cleaned sai vì "phải dừng lại" cho thấy việc dọn chưa xong.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: _____ I was watching TV, I saw the news about the floods and landslides.
questions.explain: Trước mệnh đề có chủ ngữ + động từ (I was watching) dùng liên từ While. During, Despite, Because of là giới từ, chỉ đi với danh từ/cụm danh từ.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: He was sorting the donations _____ he realised how generous people were.
questions.explain: Hành động ngắn (realised – quá khứ đơn) xen vào hành động đang diễn ra → dùng when. while thường đi với hành động kéo dài ở quá khứ tiếp diễn; during, for không nối mệnh đề theo nghĩa này.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: Kim _____ the poverty of the area while she was delivering free meals to old people.
questions.explain: Mệnh đề while + quá khứ tiếp diễn là hành động nền; hành động "nhận ra" là hành động ngắn → quá khứ đơn noticed.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: When I arrived at the community centre, a guest speaker _____ a speech, so I had to wait outside until she finished.
questions.explain: Lúc tôi đến thì bài phát biểu đang diễn ra (phải đợi đến khi bà ấy nói xong) → quá khứ tiếp diễn was giving. gave sẽ có nghĩa bắt đầu nói sau khi tôi đến, không khớp "đợi đến khi xong".

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: I first _____ Lan while we were working as volunteers.
questions.explain: Gặp lần đầu là hành động ngắn, xảy ra trong lúc hành động dài (were working) đang diễn ra → quá khứ đơn met.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: While we _____ home, we saw a girl crying near a bus stop.
questions.explain: While + quá khứ tiếp diễn (hành động đang diễn ra) + quá khứ đơn (saw) → were walking. Các thì hiện tại không phù hợp với saw.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: At 8 p.m. yesterday, we _____ for the charity concert at the community centre.
questions.explain: Thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ (At 8 p.m. yesterday) + hành động đang diễn ra → quá khứ tiếp diễn were practising.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: What _____ when the floods came to your village last year?
questions.explain: Hỏi về hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm lũ đến (when + quá khứ đơn came, last year) → were you doing. Các thì hiện tại không hợp với last year.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: When the teacher came in, the students _____ about the volunteer trip, so they stopped talking immediately.
questions.explain: Học sinh đang nói chuyện thì cô giáo vào và họ dừng lại → hành động đang diễn ra: were talking. talked mâu thuẫn với "dừng nói ngay lập tức".

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: My friend _____ me while I _____ for the charity run.
questions.explain: Hành động ngắn (gọi điện) dùng quá khứ đơn called; hành động dài sau while dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn was training. has called (hiện tại hoàn thành) không đi với mệnh đề quá khứ.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?
options: When I was meeting my old teacher, I walked to the centre.
While I met my old teacher, I was walking to the centre.
I was meeting my old teacher while I walked to the centre.
While I was walking to the centre, I met my old teacher.
questions.explain: Đi bộ là hành động dài (was walking, đi với while); gặp thầy là hành động ngắn (met). Các câu còn lại đảo thì giữa hai hành động.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: The volunteers _____ the old school when they _____ some old photos of the village.
questions.explain: Đang sửa trường (dài – quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì tìm thấy ảnh (ngắn – quá khứ đơn, sau when) → were repairing / found. find là hành động tức thời nên không dùng were finding.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: While I _____ the donations, my friend _____ them into boxes.
questions.explain: Hai hành động dài diễn ra song song trong quá khứ, nối bằng while → cả hai dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn: was sorting / was packing. "sorting" thiếu trợ động từ was; is packing, sort/packs sai thì.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: Last year, our club _____ a charity concert for the old people at the community centre.
questions.explain: Last year + hành động đã hoàn tất trong quá khứ → quá khứ đơn organised. organises (hiện tại đơn) và has organised (hiện tại hoàn thành) không đi với last year; was organising chỉ hành động đang diễn ra, không có hành động nào xen vào.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: At this time last Sunday, my classmates and I _____ rubbish on the beach.
questions.explain: At this time last Sunday = vào giờ này Chủ nhật tuần trước: thời điểm cụ thể trong quá khứ → quá khứ tiếp diễn were collecting.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: Tam _____ to the volunteer centre when she saw Kim at the bus stop, so she stopped to say hello.
questions.explain: Tam đang trên đường đến trung tâm (hành động dài) thì thấy Kim (ngắn) và dừng lại chào → was going. went sẽ hiểu là đi đến trung tâm sau khi thấy Kim, mâu thuẫn với việc dừng lại chào.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: When the bell rang, the students packed their bags and _____ the classroom.
questions.explain: Chuỗi hành động nối tiếp nhau trong quá khứ (rang → packed → left) dùng quá khứ đơn; and nối hai động từ cùng dạng packed … left. leaving, leave sai dạng; were left là bị động, sai nghĩa.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: confident /ˈkɒnfɪdənt/: o đọc /ɒ/. donate /dəʊˈneɪt/, remote /rɪˈməʊt/, hopeful /ˈhəʊpfl/: o đọc /əʊ/.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: donated /dəʊˈneɪtɪd/: -ed đọc /ɪd/ vì động từ tận cùng bằng /t/. raised /reɪzd/, delivered /dɪˈlɪvəd/, involved /ɪnˈvɒlvd/: -ed đọc /d/ (sau âm hữu thanh).

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: applied /əˈplaɪd/: -ed đọc /d/ (sau nguyên âm). helped /helpt/, worked /wɜːkt/, noticed /ˈnəʊtɪst/: -ed đọc /t/ (sau âm vô thanh /p/, /k/, /s/).

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: school /skuːl/: ch đọc /k/. charity /ˈtʃærəti/, children /ˈtʃɪldrən/, chance /tʃɑːns/: ch đọc /tʃ/.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: though /ðəʊ/: th đọc /ð/. thankful /ˈθæŋkfl/, think /θɪŋk/, health /helθ/: th đọc /θ/.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: health /helθ/: ea đọc /e/. team /tiːm/, increase /ɪnˈkriːs/ (v) hoặc /ˈɪŋkriːs/ (n), meal /miːl/: ea đọc /iː/.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ nhấn âm 2; careful /ˈkeəfl/, thankful /ˈθæŋkfl/, homeless /ˈhəʊmləs/ nhấn âm 1 (hậu tố -ful, -less không nhận trọng âm).
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: purpose /ˈpɜːpəs/ nhấn âm 1; involve /ɪnˈvɒlv/, apply /əˈplaɪ/, become /bɪˈkʌm/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: advert /ˈædvɜːt/ (danh từ) nhấn âm 1; improve /ɪmˈpruːv/, provide /prəˈvaɪd/, perform /pəˈfɔːm/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: donation /dəʊˈneɪʃn/ nhấn âm 2 (từ đuôi -tion nhấn âm ngay trước đuôi); generous /ˈdʒenərəs/, orphanage /ˈɔːfənɪdʒ/, charity /ˈtʃærəti/ nhấn âm 1.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the sentence in which the word in bold is stressed on the SECOND syllable.
options: We will record the charity show tonight.
There was a sharp increase in donations last month.
The centre keeps a record of all donations.
She gave me a small present for my birthday.
questions.explain: Từ hai âm tiết cùng cách viết: động từ nhấn âm 2, danh từ nhấn âm 1. Sau will, record là động từ /rɪˈkɔːd/. Ở các câu kia, record, increase, present là danh từ (sau a) → nhấn âm 1.

questions.topic: Stress in two-syllable words with the same spelling
questions.q: Choose the sentence in which the word in bold is stressed on the FIRST syllable.
options: We hope that the number of volunteers will increase this year.
When will you present your report about the volunteer project?
Coffee is an important export of our region.
We still import too many products from other countries.
questions.explain: export trong câu đúng là danh từ (sau an important) → /ˈekspɔːt/, nhấn âm 1. Ở các câu kia increase (sau will), present (sau will you), import (sau chủ ngữ We still) là động từ → nhấn âm 2.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
When I <u>was arriving</u> (A) at the centre, the volunteers <u>were sorting</u> (B) the donations <u>into</u> (C) boxes <u>for</u> (D) poor families.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: "đến nơi" là hành động ngắn xen vào → sửa was arriving thành arrived (When I arrived…). were sorting đúng vì là hành động đang diễn ra.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
She <u>was cleaning</u> (A) the park <u>when</u> (B) she <u>was finding</u> (C) a wallet <u>on</u> (D) the grass.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: "tìm thấy" là hành động ngắn xen vào hành động đang diễn ra (was cleaning) → sửa was finding thành found.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
We <u>saw</u> (A) many unhappy children <u>during</u> (B) we <u>were helping</u> (C) people in <u>remote</u> (D) areas.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: during là giới từ, chỉ đi với danh từ; trước mệnh đề (we were helping…) phải dùng liên từ while → sửa during thành while.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>While</u> (A) Nam <u>was painting</u> (B) the classroom, his friends <u>were repairing</u> (C) the tables <u>at the moment</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: at the moment là trạng từ của hiện tại, không dùng trong câu quá khứ → bỏ đi hoặc sửa thành at that time. Hai hành động dài song song đều dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn là đúng.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
I am very <u>interesting</u> (A) in <u>volunteering</u> (B) at the community centre <u>because</u> (C) I want to help <u>others</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: chủ ngữ là người (I) và cấu trúc be … in → phải dùng tính từ -ed: sửa interesting thành interested (be interested in).
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
The phone <u>rang</u> (A) while I <u>fill</u> (B) in the <u>application</u> (C) form <u>for</u> (D) the volunteer position.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: sau while cần hành động đang diễn ra trong quá khứ → sửa fill thành was filling (The phone rang while I was filling in…).

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Last year, our club <u>raised</u> (A) money <u>to help</u> (B) people in flooded areas, and many people were very <u>generous</u> (C) with their <u>donates</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: sau tính từ sở hữu their cần danh từ → sửa donates thành donations.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
The children felt <u>happy</u> (A) because the games <u>organised</u> (B) by the volunteers were really <u>excited</u> (C) and <u>fun</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: chủ ngữ là sự vật (the games) gây ra cảm giác → dùng tính từ -ing: sửa excited thành exciting.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It started to rain while the volunteers were planting trees.
options: The volunteers started to plant trees while it was raining.
It was raining when the volunteers started to plant trees.
The volunteers were planting trees when it started to rain.
The volunteers planted trees after it started to rain.
questions.explain: Câu gốc: các tình nguyện viên đang trồng cây thì trời bắt đầu mưa. Chỉ câu dùng were planting + when it started giữ đúng nghĩa; các câu khác đảo thứ tự sự việc hoặc biến cơn mưa thành hành động nền.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Volunteering at the centre is very interesting to me.
options: I am very interested in volunteering at the centre.
I was interested in volunteering at the centre in the past.
I am very interesting in volunteering at the centre.
Volunteering at the centre makes me very bored.
questions.explain: Việc tình nguyện thú vị với tôi = tôi rất quan tâm, thích thú việc tình nguyện: be interested in. interesting dùng cho sự vật nên câu "I am very interesting in…" sai; bored ngược nghĩa; "in the past" làm đổi thời gian.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
My brother didn't pay attention, so he made a lot of mistakes in the donation record.
options: My brother was careful, so he made a lot of mistakes in the donation record.
My brother was careless, so he made a lot of mistakes in the donation record.
My brother was careless, but he made no mistakes in the donation record.
My brother was helpful, so he made a lot of mistakes in the donation record.
questions.explain: didn't pay attention = careless (bất cẩn), dẫn đến nhiều lỗi. careful/helpful mâu thuẫn với việc mắc nhiều lỗi; "made no mistakes" đổi nghĩa câu gốc.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Tam met her old friend during her visit to the community centre.
options: While Tam met her old friend, she was visiting the community centre.
Tam was meeting her old friend when she visited the community centre.
Tam met her old friend before she visited the community centre.
Tam met her old friend while she was visiting the community centre.
questions.explain: during her visit (trong chuyến thăm) = while she was visiting: chuyến thăm là hành động dài, gặp bạn là hành động ngắn. Câu dùng was meeting … when she visited đảo vai trò; before đổi nghĩa; while không đứng trước hành động ngắn met.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
There are endless opportunities for teenagers to volunteer.
options: Teenagers have a lot of opportunities to volunteer.
Teenagers have few opportunities to volunteer.
Teenagers have no opportunities to volunteer.
The opportunities for teenagers to volunteer are ending.
questions.explain: endless = vô tận, rất nhiều → a lot of opportunities. no/few ngược nghĩa; "are ending" (đang kết thúc) hiểu sai hậu tố -less.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
When I arrived, the guest speaker was in the middle of his speech.
options: I was arriving when the guest speaker gave his speech.
The guest speaker was giving his speech when I arrived.
The guest speaker started his speech when I arrived.
The guest speaker gave his speech after I arrived.
questions.explain: in the middle of his speech = bài nói đang diễn ra → was giving his speech when I arrived. Các câu khác làm bài nói bắt đầu sau/đúng lúc tôi đến hoặc đảo vai trò hành động dài – ngắn.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
They were visiting some poor villages. They decided to help build a community centre for young people.
options: When they were deciding to help build a community centre for young people, they visited some poor villages.
While they decided to help build a community centre for young people, they were visiting some poor villages.
While they were visiting some poor villages, they decided to help build a community centre for young people.
They visited some poor villages while they were deciding to help build a community centre for young people.
questions.explain: Hành động dài (were visiting) đi với while; quyết định là hành động ngắn (decided) ở quá khứ đơn. Các phương án khác đảo vai trò dài – ngắn hoặc đặt while trước hành động ngắn.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Tim was searching for employment opportunities. He found a job advert from a non-governmental organisation.
options: Tim was searching for employment opportunities when he found a job advert from a non-governmental organisation.
Tim searched for employment opportunities when he was finding a job advert from a non-governmental organisation.
Tim searched for employment opportunities while he was finding a job advert from a non-governmental organisation.
Tim was searching for employment opportunities while he found a job advert from a non-governmental organisation.
questions.explain: Tìm việc là hành động dài (was searching), tìm thấy mẩu quảng cáo là hành động ngắn xen vào → when + quá khứ đơn found. find là hành động tức thời nên không dùng was finding; while không đứng trước hành động ngắn.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Mai was reading the job advert. Her mother came home.
options: Mai read the job advert when her mother was coming home.
When her mother came home, Mai read the job advert.
Mai was reading the job advert while her mother came home.
Mai was reading the job advert when her mother came home.
questions.explain: Mai đang đọc (dài) thì mẹ về (ngắn) → was reading + when + came. Câu "When her mother came home, Mai read…" đổi nghĩa thành đọc sau khi mẹ về; while không đứng trước hành động ngắn came; câu còn lại đảo thì hai hành động.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
I was watching TV. I saw the floods and landslides in the area.
options: While I saw the floods and landslides in the area, I was watching TV.
While I was watching TV, I saw the floods and landslides in the area.
When I was watching TV, I was seeing the floods and landslides in the area.
I watched TV while I was seeing the floods and landslides in the area.
questions.explain: Xem TV là hành động dài (While I was watching TV), thấy tin lũ lụt là hành động ngắn (saw). see thường không dùng ở thì tiếp diễn với nghĩa "nhìn thấy"; các phương án còn lại đảo vai trò hai hành động.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: a volunteer project (which was) organised by a local non-profit organisation = dự án được tổ chức bởi… (có by phía sau). organising mang nghĩa chủ động; organise là động từ nguyên thể; organisation là danh từ.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (2).
questions.explain: Collocation raise money = gây quỹ: "we raised money by selling handmade cards and cakes". rose, arose, grew là nội động từ, không có tân ngữ money.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (3).
questions.explain: "Many parents and teachers were very generous and donated clothes, books and school supplies" – hào phóng nên quyên góp quần áo, sách vở. benefited/participated/applied không đi với tân ngữ clothes theo nghĩa này.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (4).
questions.explain: "while we were cleaning the school garden, it suddenly started to rain" – while + quá khứ tiếp diễn cho hành động đang diễn ra, cơn mưa là hành động xen vào.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (5).
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ là sự vật (The whole experience) gây hứng thú → tính từ đuôi -ing: interesting. interested chỉ cảm giác của người; interest là danh từ; interestingly là trạng từ.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 4 – Getting Started – Tips (tr. 43) & Language, Vocabulary (tr. 44)

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (6).
questions.explain: apply for a position = ứng tuyển vào một vị trí; câu sau nói về điền đơn và phỏng vấn. donate (quyên góp), participate (đi với in), benefit (mang lợi ích) không đi với for positions.

questions.topic: Past simple vs. past continuous with when and while
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (7).
questions.explain: Trước mệnh đề we were walking (S + quá khứ tiếp diễn) cần liên từ while: thấy quảng cáo trong lúc đang đi bộ về. during, because of, despite là giới từ, chỉ đi với danh từ.

questions.topic: Our first volunteer jobs
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (8).
questions.explain: Danh từ chỉ người (The manager) làm chủ ngữ cho had worked → đại từ quan hệ who. which dùng cho vật; whose cần danh từ theo sau; where chỉ nơi chốn.

questions.topic: Community development
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (9).
questions.explain: Sau be (were) cần tính từ → successful: đơn của cả hai đều được chấp nhận ("If my application is successful…" trong bài Writing). success là danh từ, successfully là trạng từ, succeed là động từ.

questions.topic: Adjective suffixes: -ed vs. -ing; -ful vs. -less
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (10).
questions.explain: feel thankful for what we have = biết ơn những gì mình có (cụm trong bài Reading). careless (bất cẩn), hopeless (vô vọng), thoughtless (vô tâm) không hợp với "for what we have" và ý tích cực của câu.
